title: DIN Next Rounded / Usage
slide_intent: Specify reading settings and hierarchy because extended copy must remain clear while supporting the headline.
strategic_value: Consistent spacing and minimum size can help Duolingo’s explanatory text retain a recognizable, readable voice.
demonstration: Examples show a long headline, supporting copy beneath Feather Bold and a subheading/body passage; the rules specify spacing, minimum size and alignment.
practical_value: Choose DIN for the stated roles and check settings against medium and size.

content_islands.name: Role examples
content_islands.spec: Stack the long headline, display-face support and body-copy examples with role captions in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Text settings
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and leading, tracking, kerning, minimum size, alignment and hyphenation guidance in the right column.

reference_purposes.Application: The section assigns the face to headlines longer than 10 words, subheadings and all body copy.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source states 140% leading, tracking 0, “0, optical” kerning, minimum 14 pt/px, no full justification and no hyphenation.

ingredient.name: DIN Next Rounded settings
ingredient.role: Carry supporting and extended text clearly.
ingredient.application: Use 140% leading, tracking 0 and the printed “0, optical” kerning instruction; never below 14 pt in print or 14 px onscreen. Usually align left or center; never fully justify or hyphenate.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical guidance. Above 40 pt in print or 40 px onscreen, leading may decrease as size increases. This section says headlines longer than 10 words; its introductory specimen says 10 or longer.
